contributions.anchor: TWO PRINTED FIGURES CONFLICT and neither was chosen: the filer's own 'DONATIONS' sheet prints 'Sum 13007.94' at the foot of its 12 donor lines, while the p4 Summary Page's per-period contributions cell, Box B, prints 10975.71 (the figure this module publishes as the stated total)
contributions.detail: The 12 rows of the sheet the filer headed DONATIONS sum to exactly 13,007.94 = that sheet's own printed Sum. They do NOT equal Box B (10,975.71); 10,975.71 is the printed Sum of the OTHER sheet, the one he headed EXPENDITURES. THE FILER'S SUMMARY BOXES ARE CROSSED RELATIVE TO HIS OWN LEDGER SHEETS, and this record does NOT adjudicate it. The sheet headed 'DONATIONS' (Name / Amount) prints its own Sum 13007.94, and the summary page books 13007.94 as Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period'. The sheet headed 'EXPENDITURES' (Who / Amount) prints its own Sum 10975.71, and the summary books 10975.71 as Box B 'Contributions Received this Period'. Both sheets close to the cent on their own printed Sums, so no arithmetic is in doubt - what is in doubt is only WHICH BOX each belongs to, and that is the filer's own inconsistency. No reconciliation is therefore asserted for this side: the rows are published alongside both printed statements, exactly as the compound-cell and prose-cell precedents require, and nothing was recomputed, swapped or nudged. Box C (Year to Date) prints 10975.71, the same figure as Box B, and is in any case never summed as an increment. ONE FURTHER ARITHMETIC FACT, recorded as an observation and NOT used to assign a side: the summary's own close box prints a POSITIVE 2032.23, whereas the boxes as printed give F - D = 10975.71 - 13007.94 = -2032.23; the printed positive is what the un-crossed reading would produce. Box F itself (10975.71) follows the printed Box B (A 0 + B 10975.71), so the page supports both statements in different places. Not adjudicated.

They do NOT equal Box D (13,007.94); 13,007.94 is the printed Sum of the DONATIONS sheet. THE FILER'S SUMMARY BOXES ARE CROSSED RELATIVE TO HIS OWN LEDGER SHEETS, and this record does NOT adjudicate it. The sheet headed 'DONATIONS' (Name / Amount) prints its own Sum 13007.94, and the summary page books 13007.94 as Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period'. The sheet headed 'EXPENDITURES' (Who / Amount) prints its own Sum 10975.71, and the summary books 10975.71 as Box B 'Contributions Received this Period'. Both sheets close to the cent on their own printed Sums, so no arithmetic is in doubt - what is in doubt is only WHICH BOX each belongs to, and that is the filer's own inconsistency. The sides were assigned by CONTENT, which is unambiguous here and is the field-shift screen doing its job: this sheet's payees are GoDaddy, Paypal, Venmo, Alta Bank, RumbleUp, BCR Political, UT County and the candidate himself - vendors and a filing fee, not donors - and its column header is 'Who', while the other sheet's header is 'Name' and its entries are named individuals, couples and a company. No reconciliation is asserted. Box E (YTD) prints 13007.94 and is never summed as an increment.

in_kind_convention: monetary-only, tested both ways on both sides. Neither of the filer's own sheets carries an in-kind column, marker or annotation, and the v. 4.20 summary page has no in-kind line; there is also no offsetting contribution/expenditure pair of identical amount. Each side's rows equal its own sheet's printed Sum on the monetary-only reading (13,007.94 and 10,975.71), so adding in-kind would add nothing and both conventions agree. NOTE the convention was tested afresh here and NOT carried over from this filer's other filing in the same cycle.

notes: 6-PDF-page document = a 4-page filing + a clerk work product + a blank. Classified by each page's own printed header: p1 COVER (v. 4.20; Office box prints 'Utah County Commission Seat B'; filled radio = 'Seven days preceding Convention', which agrees with index.csv's period label; signed and dated April 4, 2022; the amendment question is answered NEITHER Yes nor No - an honest blank), p2 the filer's OWN TYPED LEDGER headed 'EXPENDITURES' with columns 'Who / Amount' and a printed 'Sum', p3 his own ledger headed 'DONATIONS' with columns 'Name / Amount' and a printed 'Sum', p4 SUMMARY PAGE (boxes A/B/C/D/E/F + an UNLETTERED close box - the v. 4.20 signature), p5 the ELECTIONS DIVISION 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' - THE CHECKLIST DECOY, zero dollar figures, two staff-reviewed copies (red ticks + 'Staff Signature #1' dated 4/4/22; a magenta-ticked 'Staff Signature #2' dated 4/4/22, whose right-hand column is left wholly unticked), the HOLD-box revision - and p6 BLANK. Checklist at p5, genuine summary at p4: the immediately-after pattern again, but located by content. NO COUNTY SCHEDULE A OR B SHEET EXISTS IN THIS FILING, and that is NOT a `no-schedule-page` state: what is missing is the county's FORM, not the filer's entries, which are all present on his own two sheets - so both sides are `transcribed`. THE SIDES ARE BOUND IN THE ORDER EXPENDITURES-THEN-DONATIONS, the reverse of the county form's Schedule A-then-B order; the record's `page` values are absolute PDF pages, so contributions live on p3 and expenditures on p2. This is why every page must be classified from its own header. THE FILER'S SUMMARY BOXES ARE CROSSED RELATIVE TO HIS OWN LEDGER SHEETS, and this record does NOT adjudicate it. The sheet headed 'DONATIONS' (Name / Amount) prints its own Sum 13007.94, and the summary page books 13007.94 as Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period'. The sheet headed 'EXPENDITURES' (Who / Amount) prints its own Sum 10975.71, and the summary books 10975.71 as Box B 'Contributions Received this Period'. Both sheets close to the cent on their own printed Sums, so no arithmetic is in doubt - what is in doubt is only WHICH BOX each belongs to, and that is the filer's own inconsistency. Both readings are recorded and neither is resolved; the rows are published under the heading each sheet itself prints, with the side assignment made by CONTENT (vendors vs named donors), and BOTH sides carry recon.result 'unknown' so that no reconciliation is claimed against a figure the rows do not equal. THE LEDGERS PRINT NO DATE COLUMN AND NO ADDRESS COLUMN, so every row's date is honestly absent (never filled in from the report date) and every donor_city/donor_state is blank because the field does not exist - the sixth documented cause of a blank donor city, and the reason all 31 rows carry needs_review=1. Amounts are printed inconsistently by the filer and kept verbatim: whole numbers with no decimal point (100, 545, 3000), one decimal place (23.1, 1045.5) and two (19.84, 707.41, 257.94). No figure is ambiguous, because each sheet's own Sum closes exactly on the reading recorded. PRIVACY: the cover is a `_Redacted` file and the county blacked out the SIGNATURE only - the candidate's street address, phone and email all print in the clear, and none is carried into this record. There are no donor addresses to redact, since the ledger has no address field. A filename is not evidence of redaction, and this filing proves the converse of its sibling: the November filing, NOT named `_Redacted`, is the one whose signature was left in the clear. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Brandon Gordon' matches index.csv; page-face office 'Utah County Commission Seat B'.
